topic: A person discovers the tree they planted as a child has been cut down
text: I just can’t shake the image from my mind, the stump where that tree used to stand. We planted it together, remember? It was this tiny sprout back then, something fragile that we watered and cared for, watched grow year after year. Now it’s just... gone. It’s like a part of my childhood vanished in one swing of an axe. I keep thinking about all the afternoons we spent under its branches, the way the leaves whispered secrets on windy days. It’s just not the same without it. I wish we could turn back time, even just a little. But we can’t. All we can do is remember, and maybe plant another one, to carry on what we started.
